title: 阿里云 AI Infra 全栈架构深度测评报告：从平头哥“算存网”芯片到灵骏、PAI 与百炼平台

sources.title: 芯片将成为撬动 AI 未来的支点（2026 云栖大会平头哥黄金家族与算存网全栈解读）
sources.read_scope: Full article text read via web_fetch
sources.excerpt_summary: Covers T-Head Zhenwu V900 (216GB HBM, 1200 GB/s interconnect, 3x M890 performance, 1000-card unified memory supernode, 500k-card cluster), Zhenwu M890 (144GB HBM3, 800 GB/s, 3x 810E), Zhenwu 810E (96GB HBM2e, 700 GB/s), ICN Switch, Panjiu AL128 supernode, Panmai 920 400G SmartNIC with integrated PCIe Switch, Zhenyue SSD controller, and Yitian 710/720/730/750 CPUs (with Yitian 750 natively supporting ICN).

sources.title: 阿里平头哥发布新一代 AI 芯片真武 V900：性能较上代提升 3 倍，明年 Q1 量产
sources.read_scope: Full article text read via web_fetch
sources.excerpt_summary: Documents the 2026 Apsara Conference announcement of Zhenwu V900 (216GB memory, 1200 GB/s interconnect, 3x M890 performance, Q1 2027 mass production), Zhenwu J900 roadmap (Q3 2028), Lingjun GP9A supernode instance powered by Zhenwu M890 running >2T-parameter models (Qwen3.8, Kimi K3), and >560,000 cumulative Zhenwu shipments across >650 enterprises.

sources.title: Alibaba unveils Zhenwu M890 AI chip with 144GB HBM3 and a roadmap through 2028
sources.read_scope: Full article text read via web_fetch
sources.excerpt_summary: Details Zhenwu M890 technical specifications: 144GB HBM3 (+50% over 810E's 96GB HBM2e), 800 GB/s inter-chip bandwidth across 8 independent ICN ports, PCIe 5.0 x16 host interface, FP32/BF16/FP16/FP8/FP4 support, 16-ch H.264/H.265 encode and 64-ch H.265 decode, ICN Switch 1.0 (25.6 Tbps capacity, <150ns P2P latency), and Panjiu AL128 supernode server (up to 64/128 accelerators).

sources.title: T-Head Zhenwu M890 GPU Specifications and Architecture Audit
sources.read_scope: Full page text read via web_fetch
sources.excerpt_summary: Verifies Zhenwu M890's 144GB HBM3, 800 GB/s ICN bandwidth, PCIe 5.0 x16, and precision support (FP32/BF16/FP16/FP8/FP4), and explicitly records the evidence boundary that T-Head's official product brief does not publish raw per-precision TFLOPS numbers (only the 3x performance claim over 810E).

sources.title: 倚天 710 Armv9 服务器芯片架构解析
sources.read_scope: Full article text read via web_fetch
sources.excerpt_summary: Describes Yitian 710 specifications: 5nm process, 60B transistors, 128 Armv9 cores up to 3.2GHz, 8-channel DDR5, and 96 lanes of PCIe 5.0.

sources.title: MemoryS 2026：平头哥镇岳 510 企业级 PCIe 5.0 SSD 主控芯片技术与规模化部署
sources.read_scope: Full article text read via web_fetch
sources.excerpt_summary: Documents Zhenyue 510 specs: XuanTie 910 RISC-V multi-core @ 1.6GHz, PCIe 5.0, 3400K IOPS, 14 GB/s sequential read, 10 GB/s sequential write, 4us latency, 420K IOPS/W, native ZNS+QLC optimization, 10^-18 UBER, >500,000 units shipped, and deployment in Alibaba Cloud EBS, OSS, and CPFS for AI workloads.

sources.title: 阿里云提出全新智算网络架构 HPN 7.0，入选顶会 SIGCOMM 2024
sources.read_scope: Full article text read via web_fetch
sources.excerpt_summary: Summarizes Alibaba Cloud's ACM SIGCOMM 2024 paper on HPN 7.0: Dual Uplink + Multi-Rail + Dual Plane architecture, 2-tier non-oversubscribed Clos connecting >15,000 GPUs via 51.2 Tbps switches, Solar-RDMA transport protocol, ACCL collective communication library, and a 14.9% improvement in LLM training efficiency.

sources.title: 阿里云官方文档：什么是文件存储 CPFS
sources.excerpt_summary: Details CPFS capabilities: up to 20 GB/s throughput in general edition, 10M IOPS, sub-millisecond latency, 10 billion files, symmetric metadata servers, POSIX/NFSv3 interoperability, and transparent block-level data flow with OSS.

sources.title: 阿里云官方文档：AI 计算资源概述（通用计算资源与灵骏智算资源）
sources.excerpt_summary: Explains PAI's unified resource layer covering General Compute 2.0 and Lingjun Intelligent Computing, resource pools, and parent-child hierarchical Quota Trees shared across DSW, DLC, and EAS.

sources.title: 阿里云官方文档：新建与管理智算灵骏资源
sources.excerpt_summary: Covers Lingjun availability in 6 regions (Ulanqab, Beijing, Shanghai, Hangzhou, Shenzhen, Singapore), subscription vs pay-as-you-go pools, and High-Speed Network Zone (hz) placement for multi-node training/inference.

sources.title: 阿里云官方文档：什么是深度学习容器（PAI-DLC）
sources.excerpt_summary: Details PAI-DLC architecture, AIMaster fault-tolerance and straggler detection, EasyCKPT asynchronous multi-tier checkpointing, and SanityCheck hardware diagnostics.

sources.title: 阿里云官方文档：模型在线服务（PAI-EAS）概述
sources.excerpt_summary: Covers PAI-EAS online model serving across CPU, GPU, and PPU heterogeneous resources, streaming/queue inference, stress testing, canary rollout, and autoscaling.

sources.title: 阿里云官方文档：购买并配置 EAS 资源组
sources.excerpt_summary: Compares Public, Dedicated, Virtual, and Quota resource groups in EAS, HPN Zone affinity scheduling for Lingjun multi-node inference, elastic resource pools, and GPU sharing.

sources.title: 阿里云官方文档：PAI GU 系列机型使用说明（GU30）
sources.excerpt_summary: Details PAI GU30 exclusive AI instances (24GB VRAM, 31 TFLOPS FP32, PCIe 4.0, matching NVIDIA A10 performance at 20%-45% lower cost).

sources.title: 阿里云官方文档：多机分布式推理（PAI-EAS Unit）
sources.excerpt_summary: Explains PAI-EAS Unit abstraction for multi-machine distributed inference, unit.guard barrier fault recovery, and dual-NIC (net0 RDMA + eth1 VPC) networking on Lingjun.

sources.title: 阿里云官方文档：使用 LLM 智能路由提升推理效率
sources.excerpt_summary: Details LLM Gateway + LLM Scheduler architecture, Anthropic API compatibility (Claude Code), prefix-cache / least-request / least-token / pd-split routing policies, and benchmark results showing 23.4%-25.0% Mean TTFT reduction on Qwen2.5-72B and QwQ-32B.

sources.title: 阿里云官方文档：基于专家并行（EP）和 PD 分离部署 MoE 模型
sources.excerpt_summary: Describes PAI-EAS production MoE deployment combining Prefill-Decode (PD) disaggregation, large-scale Expert Parallelism (EP), compute-communication overlap, and Multi-Token Prediction (MTP).

sources.title: 阿里云官方文档：训推一体资源管理（父子配额抢占）
sources.excerpt_summary: Explains how parent Quota 1 (EAS inference with preemption enabled) and child Quotas 1.1/1.2 (DLC training) share GPU clusters across peak daytime inference and off-peak nighttime training.

sources.title: 阿里云官方文档：灵骏智算配额调度策略
sources.excerpt_summary: Covers FIFO, Traversal, Balanced, and Intelligent Scheduling policies on PAI-Lingjun quotas.

sources.title: 阿里云官方文档：什么是阿里云百炼（Model Studio）
sources.excerpt_summary: Covers Bailian (Model Studio) MaaS & Agent platform architecture, Qwen3.8-Max, multi-region endpoints (Beijing, Shanghai, Virginia, Frankfurt, Singapore), OpenAI/DashScope API compatibility, and RAG vs API billing.

sources.title: 阿里云官方文档：百炼模型调优概述（CPT / SFT / DPO / RL）
sources.excerpt_summary: Details Bailian's 5-stage post-training pipeline (CPT, SFT Full/LoRA, DPO, RL, and RL Decision Model tuning), supported Qwen3.8/3.7/3.6/3.5 MoE and dense models, and per-1M-token training pricing.

sources.title: 阿里云官方文档：百炼专属部署概述（PTU、MU 与 DTU）
sources.excerpt_summary: Introduces PTU, MU, and DTU deployment modes on Alibaba Cloud Bailian.

sources.title: 阿里云官方文档：百炼 DTU 与模型单元（MU）部署详解
sources.read_scope: Full document read via web_fetch (0-30000 chars)
sources.excerpt_summary: Provides the official comparison table between DTU, PTU, Token pay-as-you-go, and PAI/Lingjun; documents MU1-MU9 specs including native PD-disaggregated (PD分离模式) configurations for Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, Qwen3.6-Plus, DeepSeek-V3.2, and GLM-5; and defines the capacity planning formula.

sources.title: 阿里云官方文档：百炼 PTU 长输入与前缀缓存（Prefix Cache 折扣与自动溢出）
sources.excerpt_summary: Documents PTU 1.5x-2.0x TPS improvement, long-input tier multipliers, Prefix Cache KTPM capacity discount factors (0.08x to 0.25x for Qwen3.8-Max, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, Qwen3.7-Plus, GLM-5.2), and overflow fallback via x-dashscope-ptu-overflow:true.
